name: Feature Request

title: "[FEAT]: "
labels: enhancement

---

### 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the requested feature.

### 🎯 Motivation & Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when wind noise drowns out voice above 80 km/h").

### 📐 Proposed Solution & Architecture
Describe the solution you'd like, including impact on KMP `sharedLogic` vs platform targets (`androidApp`, `iosApp`).

### ⚖️ Architectural Impact
* [ ] Does this affect the multiplatform protocol (`MeshPacket`)?
* [ ] Does this impact the iOS 100% Native SwiftUI boundary?
* [ ] Does this require hardware/power permissions (WakeLocks, Background Audio)?
